name: page-source
title: Page Source
description: A backend-agnostic contract for paged data (PageSource, PageRequest, PageResult) with adapters for page/size, limit/offset, cursors and keysets, Relay connections, RFC 8288 Link headers, Spring Page and Slice, and an in-memory arraySource, plus createPageController, which derives the request, resets paging, debounces search, syncs the URL and writes the live region's status.
docs: A `PageSource<T, F>` is `{ key, getId, capabilities, fetchPage(request, { signal }), fetchTotal? }`. `capabilities.position` is `"page"` or `"cursor"`; `total` says whether responses carry an exact count, an estimate or none, and navigation follows: page numbers with an exact total, previous and next with an estimate or only `hasMore`, load more for a cursor (`resolveNavigation`). Adapters build one from your `request` function and never fetch themselves: `pagedSource({ base: 0 | 1 })`, `offsetSource`, `cursorSource` (opaque, or `keyset` cursors built from the rows), `relaySource` (`edges`/`pageInfo`/`totalCount`), `linkHeaderSource` (parses `Link`, an estimate from `last`, exact on the last page), `springPageSource` (`Page<T>`, or the PagedModel of `VIA_DTO`, `sort=field,asc` repeated) and `springSliceSource`. Each takes `params: (filter) => …` for a serializer's output and `read` or `select` to map another response. Return `readJson(response)` from `request` so a failed status throws an `HttpError` with `status`. `arraySource(items, { filter, search, sort, delay, fail, count })` pages an array in memory for demos and tests, honouring abort. With Effect: `fetchPage: (request, { signal }) => Effect.runPromise(program, { signal })`. `createPageController(source, { filter, sort, sortMode, pageSize, pageSizes, search, url, labels })` holds the state outside React: a new filter, sort or size returns to page 1 (or a null cursor), `setSearch` commits after 250 ms, `url: { adapter, codec, history }` keeps it in the URL (`connect()` follows back and forward), and `statusText(result)` writes "Showing 21–40 of 312" (`labels.range` translates it).
